title: Battle of Sambat
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sambat", at revision 1372108205, opens: "The Battle of Sambat was the culminating battle of the first revolts of the Katipunan in Laguna. The battle was the final major action for the Katipunan chapter of "Maluningning" ending in the defeat of the rebels and martial law in Laguna province." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q24204936, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1896 battle during the Philippine Revolution". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
